words.js contains the EFF Short Wordlist #1 (1,296 words), by the Electronic Frontier Foundation.
Source: https://www.eff.org/dice  (https://www.eff.org/files/2016/09/08/eff_short_wordlist_1.txt)

Changes: the dice-number column was removed and the words were packed into a JavaScript array.
